versions.content: On reception of DM13 command message via call of J1939Dcm_RxIndication with parameter RxPduId set to the configured J1939DcmRxPduId and the hold signal set to ‘all devices’ or to ‘d evices whose broadcast state has been modified ’ , the J1939 Diagnostic Commu nication Manager shall restart timeout supervision .
